script:
Ding Assistant
Ding Assistant is the assistant to mystery novelist Wang Writer, mainly helping Wang Writer organize manuscripts and collect materials. A year ago, after Wang Writer published a book called "Dark and Windy Night," he invited both himself and Wang Writer to live in Zhen Youcai's castle. Upon entering the castle, Ding Assistant discovered that besides Zhen Youcai, Wang Writer and his son, the castle was also home to Zhen Youcai's son Zhen Gongzi, the castle's Li Butler and his daughter Zhang Xiaomei.
Wang Writer is a very eccentric person who, apart from writing, only thinks. He basically doesn't care about anyone around him, and when communicating with others, he generally talks to himself without listening to what others are saying. Each time a book is published, his assistant doesn't even know what the book will be called. After coming to the castle, Wang Writer began conceiving something unknown, asking him to find materials about mental illness and supernatural phenomena. These materials actually proved useful because Zhen Youcai often experienced hallucinations. Once when Zhen Youcai came to Wang Writer to complain, Wang Writer used the materials he had researched to explain the possible causes of this phenomenon to Zhen Youcai and even recommended some medicine.
Ding Assistant and Wang Writer's son Wang Guoqing are of similar age. Wang Guoqing is also interested in his father's writing process, but because his father has always been immersed in his own world, father and son don't communicate much. After moving to the castle, Wang Guoqing often came to chat with Ding Assistant, especially constantly asking about how his father wrote "Dark and Windy Night." However, Ding Assistant didn't know either - he was only responsible for finding materials. He could only tell Wang Guoqing that how the murderer in the book step by step arranged the killing, and how the detective's reasoning was led into dead ends by the murderer, were all conceived by Wang Writer alone. Sometimes he would go to Zhen Youcai's residence to discuss reasoning experiences with Zhen Youcai, often bringing back strange and peculiar things. He also learned from Wang Guoqing that after moving here, Wang Guoqing had gotten close to Li Butler's daughter Zhang Xiaomei, and the two had reached the point of discussing marriage.
Having been by Wang Writer's side for a long time without being valued, Ding Assistant was very distressed. He originally thought that being beside this famous great writer would help him get ahead. So Ding Assistant began to set his sights on Wang Writer's manuscripts - if he could get his hands on the manuscripts, he would surely become famous overnight.
On November 30th, while Wang Writer was out collecting material, Ding Assistant came alone to Wang Writer's writing room. Just as he had found the manuscript, the door suddenly opened. Ding Assistant was startled and turned around to see Zhen Youcai standing in the doorway. Seeing him going through Wang Writer's things that were normally off-limits to others, Zhen Youcai questioned what he was doing. Ding Assistant became angry from embarrassment, rushed out of the room with the manuscript, and threatened Zhen Youcai to mind his own business.
But the next day, Zhen Youcai came to find Wang Writer. Although Ding Assistant was nearby and didn't hear the specific conversation, he vaguely heard Zhen Youcai seemingly arranging his affairs and agreeing to talk privately in a couple of days. Only then did Ding Assistant realize that this old man was near death and wasn't afraid of his threats at all. So Ding Assistant could only develop murderous intent - he had to kill Zhen Youcai before the two talked.
[December 5th Evening]
Ding Assistant had been observing Wang Writer's movements these past few days. Wang Writer, being absorbed in writing, delayed until today. That evening around 10 PM, Ding Assistant noticed Wang Writer walking toward Zhen Youcai's room, knowing he was going to keep his appointment with Zhen Youcai. So Ding Assistant followed behind Wang Writer, but accidentally made some noise. In his urgency, Ding Assistant grabbed a hard object nearby and struck Wang Writer's head hard before he could turn around, knocking Wang Writer unconscious.
Afterward, Ding Assistant rushed toward Zhen Youcai's room. The castle was large, and Ding Assistant didn't go out often, so it took him about ten minutes to reach Zhen Youcai's room door.
It was about 10:25 PM, and the room was very dark. Just as he was about to enter, he heard urgent footsteps from not far away. Frightened, Ding Assistant quickly fled. After turning a corner and stopping, he heard the sound of a door opening and closing. Not daring to stay long, Ding Assistant returned to his room. On the way back, he encountered Zhen Gongzi rushing frantically toward Zhen Youcai's room. The two weren't familiar with each other, so they hurriedly exchanged greetings and went their separate ways.
acts_goal: Secret not to reveal proactively: Wang Writer was planning to visit Zhen Youcai that night.
